pages.text: StarMine carries no Blizzard assets: Modkit takes the models, textures and sounds from your own copy of StarCraft II. Without them every unit and building is drawn by StarMine's own stand-in, built of coloured blocks in its race's colours — soldiers, beasts, vehicles, ships, walkers and buildings — with glowing eyes, crystals and engines.
Stand-ins: marines, a hellion, a siege tank, a thor, an overlord.
